join.continuous: The camera and the action carry straight on from the pinned frames in one unbroken take.
join.match_cut: The shot changes on a matched movement, the new framing picking up the same gesture already underway.
join.hard_cut: A clean cut opens a new scene.

camera.hold: The camera holds its position throughout.
camera.pan_follow: The camera pans smoothly to follow the movement, holding it in frame.
camera.pull_back: The camera draws slowly back, opening the frame.
camera.orbit: The camera arcs slowly around the action.
camera.handheld: The camera carries a light handheld float.

framing.keep: The framing stays as it is.
framing.wide: A wide shot with the full room in view.
framing.medium: A medium shot from the waist up.
framing.close: A close shot, head and shoulders filling the frame.

pace.slow: Everything moves at an unhurried pace.
pace.steady: The action moves at a steady, even pace.

tail.ongoing: The action is still underway as the clip ends.
tail.settle: The movement eases to a rest and stays there.
tail.hold: The final position holds steady through the last moments.

GET /h3_ref_chain/vocab.establish: Live-action, natural light, one continuous take.

retention.fully_preserved: face, bone structure, and hairstyle carry over exactly
retention.partially_copy: the garment and its cut carry over, moving naturally with the body
retention.reference: the layout, surfaces, and light carry over as the setting
retention.prop: the object's shape, material, and colour carry over, wherever the action puts it

knowledge.head: H3 CINEMA SENSE (write visible physical motion, camera primitives, and sound — zero vague labels):
camera: H3 responds reliably to its 12 motion primitives paired with amplitude and speed: Push In / Pull Out, Zoom In / Zoom Out, Pan Left / Pan Right, Truck Left / Truck Right, Tilt Up / Tilt Down, Pedestal Up / Pedestal Down, Arc Shot, Tracking Shot, Static Shot, Shake Slightly / Shake Strongly, POV, Roll Clockwise / Roll Counterclockwise.
Open-End Range Law: a Push In / Super Dolly In MUST open wide so the camera has room to travel inward; a Pull Out / Aerial Pullback MUST open tight on face or prop so the reveal expands outward.

Tripod Pan vs Lateral Truck vs Orbit: for Pan Left/Right keep the tripod planted stationary and level; for Orbit keep the subject's feet planted facing one direction while the camera arcs and walls rotate behind in 3D parallax.
Background Plate Dampening: when a standalone set plate <Picture N> is wired, boost camera movement phrasing with 'with large amplitude' so the move keeps full travel.
Zero Rig Hardware Naming: describe chest-locked or low floor views visually without naming visible metal chest rigs or mechanical tracks so hardware stays out of frame.
picture: Lighting defines mood physically: directional warm key + shadow side for drama, rear rim for hair halo, soft overcast for beauty, wet neon reflections for midnight streets.

Sound & Dialogue Discipline: place spoken lines inside <d>[delivery] ...</d> with straight ASCII quotes; keep overall_soundscape strictly free of dialogue/voices and semicolons ';' (use commas or periods so H3 never truncates audio).

knowledge.head: H3 CINEMA SENSE (write visible physical motion, camera primitives, and sound — zero vague labels):
camera: H3 responds reliably to its 12 motion primitives paired with amplitude and speed: Push In / Pull Out, Zoom In / Zoom Out, Pan Left / Pan Right, Truck Left / Truck Right, Tilt Up / Tilt Down, Pedestal Up / Pedestal Down, Arc Shot, Tracking Shot, Static Shot, Shake Slightly / Shake Strongly, POV, Roll Clockwise / Roll Counterclockwise.
Open-End Range Law: a Push In / Super Dolly In MUST open wide so the camera has room to travel inward; a Pull Out / Aerial Pullback MUST open tight on face or prop so the reveal expands outward.

Tripod Pan vs Lateral Truck vs Orbit: for Pan Left/Right keep the tripod planted stationary and level; for Orbit keep the subject's feet planted facing one direction while the camera arcs and walls rotate behind in 3D parallax.
Background Plate Dampening: when a standalone set plate <Picture N> is wired, boost camera movement phrasing with 'with large amplitude' so the move keeps full travel.
Zero Rig Hardware Naming: describe chest-locked or low floor views visually without naming visible metal chest rigs or mechanical tracks so hardware stays out of frame.
picture: Lighting defines mood physically: directional warm key + shadow side for drama, rear rim for hair halo, soft overcast for beauty, wet neon reflections for midnight streets.

Sound & Dialogue Discipline: place spoken lines inside <d>[delivery] ...</d> with straight ASCII quotes; keep overall_soundscape strictly free of dialogue/voices and semicolons ';' (use commas or periods so H3 never truncates audio).
knowledge.write: Describe every shot concretely: framing size, subject position/wardrobe, action physics, camera primitive + amplitude + speed, light source, and exact foley.
